body.x: Chinese companies that want to sell abroad need more than a booth at a foreign trade show. They also need market information and, ideally, a first-hand look at the local market.
That is the part of the process Mars International Exhibition handles.

Mars International Exhibition Co.,Ltd, an overseas exhibition agency based in Beijing and established in 2019, is led by Zou Le and is participating in KES 2026. The company has represented a range of domestic and international exhibitions and focuses on industries such as technology, consumer electronics, household appliances, components and home gifts.

Its overseas exhibitions cover dozens of countries and regions, including Germany, the United States, Poland, Turkey, Japan, South Korea, Russia and Southeast Asia, and it says it serves leading Chinese brands and fast-growing enterprises as they go global. Besides collecting market information at the exhibition itself, Mars arranges market investigations so that clients can visit the local market directly and gather information at first hand.
According to its application, Mars currently exports to three countries: Vietnam, Indonesia and Thailand. It aims to raise its export share from 23% today to 40% by 2027.

KES 2026, the 57th Korea Electronics Show, runs Oct. 13 to Oct. 16 at COEX Halls A and B in Seoul. Alongside the co-located XR & Spatial Computing Show, the event features X-SPACE 2026, a special exhibition covering digital twins, industrial XR, spatial intelligence, XR devices and spatial computing platforms. The Innovation Awards ceremony takes place on Oct. 13.
